raw_text: Opinion | The Doklam Ghost: China's Recycled Imagery Campaign and India's Response Deficit — Indian Express, June 12, 2024. The recent circulation of PLA footage from the Doklam plateau is not a military development but an information warfare exercise. Open-source analysts have conclusively demonstrated that the imagery dates to August 2017. Yet this manufactured crisis has already consumed two news cycles in India. New Delhi's slow response to cognitive warfare operations creates a vacuum that adversarial narratives fill. India urgently needs a dedicated strategic communications cell to counter such operations in real time rather than after the damage is done.
